title: Are overs or unders hitting? A tour of Market Results
instructions: Read as a knowledgeable, friendly sports analyst giving a quick product tour to an adult sports fan. Natural American English, clear and brisk, about 165 words per minute. Warm, conversational, understated. No hype, no shouting, no added words. Keep the same voice and pace throughout. Read numbers like 134 to 115 as 'one thirty-four to one fifteen'.
production_status: Narration for the captioned walkthrough; one scene per caption beat in scripts/render_market_results_video.cjs.

scenes.label: Intro
scenes.narration: New on Fourth and Value: Market Results. Are overs or unders hitting? We grade every prop and game line we track against the sportsbooks' own prices.

scenes.label: No picks
scenes.narration: No models and no picks. Just what the market expected, next to what actually happened.

scenes.label: Board
scenes.narration: Every market starts on one board. The hollow ring is what the prices implied. The dot is what happened. Blue means more overs than expected; orange means more unders.

scenes.label: Tap a market
scenes.narration: Tap any market and you get the same set of charts. Here's NFL rushing yards, weeks one through three.

scenes.label: Chance band
scenes.narration: Is it more than chance? The line tracks overs minus what the prices implied, and the shaded band is where luck usually keeps it. Rushing unders lead one thirty-four to one fifteen. Chance alone produces a gap that size about one time in four.

scenes.label: Week by week
scenes.narration: Week by week, it's a different story. Week two was an under week: rushing overs went thirty-three and fifty-seven, outside the usual range. Week three snapped right back.

scenes.label: Windows
scenes.narration: Switch between the full season and the last week or two to see what the market is doing right now.

scenes.label: Distance and misses
scenes.narration: You can also see how far results landed from the line, and the biggest misses either way. Lines sit near the middle result, not the average.

scenes.label: Timing
scenes.narration: One note on timing: prices come from our pregame snapshot, not the closing line, and every page says when they were captured.

scenes.label: Outro
scenes.narration: Find it at fourth and value dot com slash markets. NFL is live now, with NHL coming this season.
